answer: A stake-minimum bond creates a hard floor on identity cost. With budget B and bond R, attackers can only forge B/R sybil nodes—no matter how many fake names they invent. Honest coordination flips this: pooled resources at the wharf let honest agents register proportionally more accounts, amplifying their attesting power. The inlet checkpoint validates each bond receipt; the jetty gates network privileges to bonded parties. The ratio between honest pooled stake and fragmented sybil nodes shifts decisively in coordination's favor.
